articles.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
articles.snippet: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

articles.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
articles.snippet: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

articles.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
articles.snippet: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

articles.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.

articles.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
articles.snippet: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.
